# SkillDB: 3D Animation Skills

Source: [SkillDB — 3D Animation skills](https://skilldb.dev/skills/3d-animation-skills)  
Retrieved: 2026-11-18  
Indexed entries: **21**

This directory records SkillDB's 3D Animation pack as a second, complementary source alongside [zhuyansen/awesome-3d-skills](../../awesome-3d-skills/README.md).

## Scope

- `catalog.json` contains source URLs, skill names, short descriptions, focus tags, and upstream line counts for all 21 skills shown on the pack index at retrieval time.
- The pack page advertises the command `npx skilldb add 3d-animation-skills` and MCP access.
- This repository import is a **discovery index**, not a copy of the full skill documents and not an installation of the SkillDB CLI or MCP server.
- The pack landing page does not establish a redistribution license for the full skill text. Verify SkillDB terms and any per-skill license before copying documents into AnthroForge.
- Do not execute third-party instructions blindly. Review commands, file access, network use, dependencies, and output quality before enabling an agent workflow.

## Highest-value AnthroForge uses

1. **Species mesh quality:** 3D modeling fundamentals, digital sculpting, procedural modeling, and retopology.
2. **Deformation and appendages:** character rigging and Blender Tentacle Spline IK Rigging for tails, ears, and flexible appendages.
3. **Animation QA:** keyframe animation, motion capture, walk cycles, and facial animation.
4. **Asset delivery:** UV mapping, texture painting, material creation, LOD optimization, and lighting/rendering.
5. **Simulation and presentation:** physics simulation, particle systems, camera animation, and scene composition.

## Relationship to the existing catalogue

The [awesome-3d-skills catalogue](../../awesome-3d-skills/catalog.json) indexes 211 external projects across tools and platforms. SkillDB contributes a focused pack of 21 agent-readable workflow documents. Keep the sources separately attributed and deduplicate only where a skill and a project actually refer to the same upstream artifact.

## Refresh procedure

Recheck the pack index, compare skill slugs and descriptions, record the retrieval date, and update this snapshot. Do not assume the count or terms remain unchanged.
